title: When the Drop Wakes
author: Wendell Ishikawa
blurb: Sebastian Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
